title: Mid-market Customer Success Manager
description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. 

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values 

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: 

- Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. 

- Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. 

- Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. 

🤝 The team 

You will join our Global MidMarket Customer Success team, a group of Customer Success Managers who each own a broad, evolving portfolio of mid-market accounts. While the function operates globally, this specific opening is dedicated to the EMEA & APAC regions 

Based in Paris, you will work closely with 2 Mid-Market CSMs (1 in London, 1 in NYC) and 1 Scale Ops Manager (Paris). Matthieu , Head of Scale CSM and your manager, based in Paris, will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our international offices. 

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide: 

- Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts 

- Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment 

- Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth. Split between Enterprise CSMs , who build deep, tailored relationships with a small number of strategic accounts, and Mid-Market CSMs , who manage a larger book of accounts with a focus on speed and ROI, acting where and when it counts 

- Support Engineers : Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience 

🖋️ Your responsibilities 

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager, you will own a broad portfolio of Mid-Market accounts end-to-end. Working at pace and using usage data and account signals to prioritize your day, you will make sure your accounts renew, stay healthy, and grow, spotting upsell/expand opportunities as proactively as you spot churn risk, and owning both through to close. 

This is a role for someone energized by volume and by building repeatable, data-driven ways of working across a large book of business, without losing the client-first mindset that drives portfolio growth. 

Portfolio Ownership & Signal-Driven Execution (60%) 

Own the business performance and KPIs of a large portfolio of Mid-Market accounts, and take individual accountability for contributing to team and company targets: 

- Own your portfolio's KPIs (usage, renewal rate, NRR, churn) end to end with a hunter/rescuer mindset: moving fast to capture opportunity, and stepping in decisively when an account is at risk 

- Structure your coverage around two core touchpoints, kickoff and renewal, complemented by additional touchpoints where and when the data calls for it 

- Continuously monitor usage data, health scores, and other signals to prioritize your day and catch risk or opportunity early 

- React quickly and decisively on negative signals to protect the account, and on positive signals to capture upsell potential 

- Judge, account by account, how much time and effort a situation deserves, and adjust your touchpoint cadence accordingly - guided increasingly by shared scoring and playbooks as the Scale motion matures 

Product & Industry Expertise (20%) 

Build broad product and industry expertise to support adoption at scale, rather than deep knowledge of any single client: 

- Develop a strong understanding of UpSlide's product and of the industries your portfolio operates in 

- Contribute to adoption initiatives such as webinars and open office hours, sharing your expertise across the client base 

Scale Motion Optimization (10%) 

Bring a critical eye to how the Mid-Market motion runs, and help make it faster and more effective: 

- Share structured feedback on where automation and process changes can save time 

- Suggest and help build content that increases client engagement and adoption 

- Work closely with the Scale Ops Manager and the Head of Scale to turn feedback into concrete improvements 

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%) 

Stay connected to the teams around your portfolio, notably those handling first-line requests: 

- Sync regularly with Support and Sales Admin, who own level 1 requests and escalate to you when needed 

- Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities that require broader support 

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, Notion (or local equivalents). 

⚡ Your goals 

What you'll be assessed on: 

- Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 

- Churn 

- Upsell / Expansion contribution 

- CRM data quality and forecast accuracy 

You are a great fit if you have: 

- 2/3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role in a B2B environment 

- Proven experience managing renewals and churn across a portfolio of accounts, with the confidence to handle difficult conversations (renegotiation, dissatisfaction) as needed 

- Proven ability to identify and close expansion/upsell opportunities, with a hunter mindset and a strong ROI orientation 

- Experience autonomously managing a sizeable portfolio, ideally including Mid-Market accounts 

- A structured, analytical approach to account planning at volume , using data to prioritize a broad book of business and anticipate risk 

- Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting 

- Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English 

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment 

We’d love it if you have: 

- Experience with analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent) 

- Advanced negotiation skills 

- Knowledge of the financial services / professional services sector 

- Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership 

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. 

Recruitment process 

- Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role. 

- Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. 

- Case study + team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team. 

- Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps. 

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer 

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries 

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year) 

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm 

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget 

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities 

👶 Family support: 

- Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents 

- 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement 

- Flexible return to work options 

- An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent 

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day) 

✅ General: 

- Meal vouchers (Tickets resto) : €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year) 

- Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle) : Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children 

- Commute (Transports) : Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide 

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

- Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.

How we work in 2026 

Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. For our mobile team, that shifts where the value is: when AI handles more of the code, what matters most is how the app looks, how it feels, what it does for the user and the ideas you bring to it. Understanding the product and the people using it sits at the heart of the role: we expect engineers to know why they're building something, not just how.

Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill and if you'd rather not work this way, that's fair but we're probably not the place for you. Equally, if you see mobile engineering as getting code onto a screen and calling it "good enough", this probably isn't the role for you either.

We're a small, autonomous mobile team working on what we think is the best PropTech app on the market. There's no micromanagement and no fixed sprint rituals: when a new project kicks off we get together as a "three amigos" with product and design, get the first tickets out, then keep the conversation going as the work develops. You'll have dedicated backend, design and product colleagues alongside you, and full freedom over how you work.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in!

- Owning the end-to-end delivery of significant features in our React Native app: scoping the problem, directing the build, testing, shipping and iterating based on what you learn.

- Directing agent sessions to deliver work, while your own attention goes on the user experience, platform feel and the decisions where your judgement is required.

- Making every experience feel natural on both iOS and Android - understanding what users on each platform expect, and building for it.

- Being a regular voice in product discussions: taking a loose "what if we..." idea and turning it into a strong first version.

- Picking up tech debt and spotting improvements alongside your main feature, keeping the app maintainable and extendable.

- Helping to shape new mobile work as it expands across more of the business, including consumer monetisation and lettings.

A bit about you

- You have commercial experience building and shipping production apps with React Native and TypeScript, on both iOS and Android.

- You work AI-natively as a default, using tools like Claude Code fluently - and you understand what the AI produces well enough to explain and own it. If your current employer doesn't allow AI tools, we'd expect you've been exploring them in your own time.

- You have strong product and design sense: you're user-focused and care about how something feels to use, not just whether it works.

- You take quality seriously - your work is tested, solid and thought through before it ships.

- You've looked after a live app and see its stability, monitoring and releases as part of your job.

- You're comfortable working independently with loose guidelines, and you're a confident communicator who'll share ideas and challenge in discussions.

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

Who We Are 

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the Platform Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be 

In the Platform Engineering team, you will build the next generation of the internal developer platform behind Spread Group's core services - a cloud-native platform on AWS, designed from the ground up. We see our platform as a product and our developers as our customers.

This is a greenfield build with real design freedom: you shape the architecture, the golden paths and the self-service capabilities - not just keep existing systems running. Your platform will serve roughly 175 services from 13 product teams in our European and North American regions. Today they run on more than a dozen Kubernetes clusters with around 280 nodes and 4,000 running pods - migrating them step by step onto the new platform while everything keeps running is a core part of the mission.

What You´ll Do 

- Build the next-generation cloud-native platform on AWS - you own the architecture and design decisions from day one

- Design and build platform services, APIs and self-service capabilities that let teams build, deploy and operate their core services end-to-end

- Provide "golden paths": standardized templates, pipelines and building blocks that get teams to production quickly and safely

- Build and evolve the AWS cloud infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code, including Kubernetes and managed services

- Keep the platform secure, reliable and cost-efficient

- Work closely with development teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience

- Maintain the existing on-premises infrastructure and Kubernetes landscape - keeping all services reliably running while the migration to AWS is underway

- Guide the migration of roughly 175 existing services onto the new platform

What You´ll Bring 

- Several years of professional experience (mid-level to senior) in software engineering, ideally in platform engineering, SRE or DevOps - a computer science degree is welcome but not required

The account is a large, Azure-first Data Intelligence Platform customer. It runs a portfolio of well over a hundred use cases across business units and global functions, delivered as a multi-year program in quarterly releases. You will set the technical direction for that program and turn it into an executable roadmap. You will work as one team with the Account Executive and a dedicated pod of Solutions Architects, specialists, Professional Services and partners. We are looking for a visionary who can see where Data + AI will take health technology, explain that clearly to executives and engineers alike, and bring a large, distributed group of people with them!

Own and drive the technical vision 

- Define the customer's enterprise Data + AI vision with CxO and VP stakeholders, tied directly to business priorities. Be the executive suite's trusted advisor on platform strategy, build-vs-buy, responsible AI and regulated-industry governance.

- Proven record as lead technical figure on a large global enterprise account, or as enterprise/chief architect at a similar organisation, owning the vision over multiple years.

- Experience leading virtual teams without direct authority: setting direction, coaching senior architects and aligning specialists, delivery and partners on one plan.

- Deep, hands-on expertise in modern data and AI platforms; Apache Spark, Delta Lake and Databricks experience is a strong plus.

- Experience designing:

- Large-scale data platforms and migrations from legacy warehouses, Hadoop or other clouds

- Enterprise governance and security models

- Production ML, MLOps, GenAI and agent systems

- Proven ability to win platform decisions against hyperscaler-native and competing platforms on architecture, cost and governance.

- Proficient in Python and SQL; able to prototype quickly, including with AI-assisted development.

Domain knowledge 

- Experience in health technology, medical devices, life sciences or another regulated industry, and a passion for improving patient outcomes with Data + AI.

- Working knowledge of MedTech and medical AI regulation:

- EU MDR/IVDR

- FDA SaMD and Predetermined Change Control Plans

- ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and ISO 14971

- EU AI Act requirements for high-risk medical AI

- Understanding of privacy and data-sharing regimes (GDPR, HIPAA, European Health Data Space). Familiarity with healthcare data standards (DICOM, HL7, FHIR, OMOP).

Nice to Have

- Experience with or at a global MedTech, health technology or diagnostics company.

- Experience designing validated, audit-ready (GxP / 21 CFR Part 11) data and AI environments. Enterprise-scale SAP data integration (BW, S/4HANA) and semantic harmonisation.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements 

- Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

- Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

- Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

- Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

- Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

You will combine strong engineering with product judgement, taking ideas from early prototypes through to reliable features and using real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and building complete agent-powered features, from frontend interfaces and application state to backend services, APIs and data storage.

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer 

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero 

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity .

Your team 

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters 

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like 

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

· Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

· Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

· Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

· Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

· Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

· Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

· Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves 

· A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

· Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

· Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

· Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

· Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

· Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

· You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

· You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves 

· Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

· Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

· Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

· Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

· Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

· Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero 

· Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

· Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

· Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

· International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

· Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis. 

What we offer 

· A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

· A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

· Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

· Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.

Application process 

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

We would like the new colleague to start as soon as possible. Interested? Apply via the button below with your CV and a short motivation. For questions, please contact Veroniek Smits, our Corporate Recruiter, at 

Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Machine Learning Engineer - IV (Computer Vision)
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision) 

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

- Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.

- Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX

- Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.

- Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

- Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For 

- Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

Jumio Values: 

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities : 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. 

About Jumio: 

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Applicant Data Privacy 

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

title: Director, Engineering, Platform/Services
description:
About Life360 

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. 

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Our Services engineering teams, part of our Quality and Scale Pillar, build and run the systems every Life360 member relies on but never sees. We carry location data between members’ phones and our servers, deliver the push and SMS notifications that families depend on, verify who members are and what they can access, build and scale our business critical services and give partners a safe way to build on Life360. When we do our jobs well, product teams ship faster and families trust the app in the moments that matter most.

We are a group of backend, cloud, and mobile engineers who care about reliability, security, and scale, and who treat member trust as the foundation of everything we build.

About the Job

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams building and operating Life360’s critical platforms, including location and messaging, cloud infrastructure and identity, and partner ecosystems. These systems are the foundation of the experiences millions of families rely on every day. You are a player coach who will set technical direction, develop strong engineering managers and technical leaders, and ensure our platforms are reliable, secure, and built to scale as Life360 grows to hundreds of millions of members worldwide.

This is a leadership role that combines deep technical judgment with business impact. You will anticipate scaling challenges before they become problems, modernize critical systems, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, and speed. You will partner closely with Product, Security, Data, and engineering leaders to connect technology investments to business outcomes, accelerate product innovation, and build an engineering organization that can deliver at scale.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $216,500 to $318,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 251,000 to 295,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. 

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You’ll Do

- Build the foundation for scale. Lead the engineering teams behind Life360’s critical services, including location and messaging, cloud and identity, and partner platforms. Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems that can support hundreds of millions of members around the world.

- See around corners. Anticipate architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scaling challenges before they impact members. Set technical direction, modernize legacy systems, and balance near-term business needs with long-term platform investments.

- Make reliability a competitive advantage. Establish high standards for availability, performance, observability, security, and incident response. Build resilient systems that proactively detect and prevent failures, ensuring members can trust Life360 in the moments that matter most.

title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering
- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
- Regular use of an AI coding tool
- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
- At least 10 hours a week, starting now
- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: (Senior) Penetration Tester / Red Teamer (m/w/d)
description:
Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology".

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

(Senior) Penetration Tester / Red Teamer (m/w/d) 

Das erwartet Dich:

- Offensive Security : Du führst eigenständig Penetrationstests durch, identifizierst Schwachstellen in komplexen IT-Landschaften und analysierst Angriffswege über Netzwerk-, System- und Anwendungsebenen hinweg 

- Realistische Angriffssimulation : Du stellst Sicherheitsketten eines Unternehmens im Rahmen von Advanced Cyber Attacks und Red Teaming Assessments auf die Probe 

- Technisches Consulting : Du berätst unsere Kunden herstellerunabhängig zu modernen Sicherheitsarchitekturen, Angriffsszenarien und Best Practices und führst Audits / Whitebox-Reviews mit technischem Schwerpunkt durch 

- Analyse & Reporting : Du bereitest technische Ergebnisse zielgruppengerecht auf, machst komplexe Angriffe verständlich und leitest daraus konkrete, umsetzbare Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden ab 

- Research & Development : Du wirkst aktiv bei der Entwicklung neuer Angriffstechniken, Tools, Automatisierungen und Infrastruktur mit 

- Gemeinsame Expertise : Du wirst Teil eines hochqualifizierten Teams, in dem jeder seine Spezialgebiete einbringt und gemeinsam zum Erfolg des gesamten Teams beiträgt

Das bringst Du mit:

- Erfahrung : Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security mit Fokus auf Penetration Testing und/oder Red Teaming 

- Technisches Know-how : Fundierte Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Entra-ID, Enterprise-Netzwerken und/oder Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure etc.) 

- OT/ICS-Erfahrung : Praktische Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Assessments in kritischen OT-/ICS-Umgebungen sowie in der Bewertung von Risiken und Ableitung pragmatischer Maßnahmen zur Stärkung der Cyber-Resilienz 

- Development Skills : Programmiererfahrung, idealerweise in Python, Go, Java, oder C# 

- Mindset : Du verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst neue Perspektiven in komplexe Security-Herausforderungen ein („think outside the box“) 

- Kommunikation : Du hast Freude an der Beratung, bringst technische Inhalte klar auf den Punkt und kannst sie sowohl Fachteams als auch dem Management verständlich vermitteln 

- Arbeitsweise : Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und analytisch, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte und lieferst eigenständig Ergebnisse auf hohem Niveau 

- Sprachkenntnisse : Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 

- Reisebereitschaft : Du bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von rund 30 % mit. Dazu gehören gelegentlich auch internationale Reisen 

- Nice to have : Zertifizierungen wie OSCP, OSWA/OSWE, CRTO, SANS oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen 

Was Dich aber vor allem erwartet:

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

title: Backend Engineer (Multiple Positions)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Backend Engineer 

About LaunchDarkly Engineering 

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the role 

We have multiple backend engineering roles open on various teams. The specific level, scope, and technical focus will be aligned to the opportunity and the candidate’s experience. Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, SDK engineering, data infrastructure, observability, or AI/agent systems may be relevant for some teams.

As a Backend Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will design, build, and operate the services that power reliable software delivery for our customers. You may work on APIs, distributed systems, configuration and event pipelines, data services, SDK-related infrastructure, platform capabilities, or backend systems supporting our product experiences.

You will work with experienced engineers, Product, Design, and partner teams to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to own work from early design through production, learn from real customer impact, and contribute to systems that operate at meaningful scale.

What you’ll do 

- Design, implement, test, and operate production services and APIs.

- Lead projects or meaningful components of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.

- Make thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.

- Improve the observability and operability of the systems you own, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and incident learnings.

- Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to understand needs and deliver useful outcomes.

- Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and learning from teammates.

- Investigate production issues calmly and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements.

- Contribute to a culture of inclusive collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Qualifications 

- 5+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and API design.

- Experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language. (Most of our teams use Go) 

- Experience designing or contributing to services that need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable as usage grows.

- Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

- A collaborative approach and a sense of ownership for both your work and its downstream customer impact.

- Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and working through ambiguous problems.

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $ 145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Product
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role 
As a Senior Data Scientist for Product at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team . We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company, hiring for the person , not the seat. Depending on your strengths and where we have the biggest gap when you join, you could be embedded primarily with:

- Product : instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.

- Finance & RevOps : ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.

- Growth & Marketing : acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

- GTM & Customer Success : pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

What you will be doing 

- Partner with stakeholders across Product, Finance, GTM, Growth, and beyond to translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.

- Define the metrics that matter, design the experiments or analyses that test them, and measure the impact of what we ship.

- Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.

- Model the data you need for your work in dbt, pulling in new sources when necessary, and partner closely with data engineering on anything that needs to scale beyond your immediate use case.

- Build dashboards and reporting that scale beyond you, so the company can answer its own questions where possible.

- Help shape how the data team operates as we scale: standards, tooling, ways of working.

What you'll need 

- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python .

- Solid grasp of data modelling and what it takes to build analytical work that is reliable and trusted.

- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to influence decisions through data storytelling, including pushing back when the data doesn't support what someone wants to do.

- Genuine depth in at least one of the following, with competence across the rest and curiosity to grow:

- Data modelling and analytics engineering (dbt, dimensional modelling, semantic layers, self-service)

- Experimentation and causal inference (A/B test design, quasi-experiments, statistical rigour)

- Machine learning and applied data science (forecasting, prediction, segmentation, evaluation)

- Product analytics and metric design (funnels, cohorts, adoption frameworks, North Star metrics)

Nice to have 

- Experience in a product-led or SaaS environment, ideally B2B.

- Hands-on experience with our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Hex, Dagster .

- Prior experience as an early data hire at a fast-growing company, i.e. you've built the muscle, not inherited it.

Most importantly, you are someone who 

- "Gets stuff done" and understands building a $10bn company isn't always glamorous and takes hard work and long hours.

- Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the answers aren't always clear and processes are few.

- Is genuinely domain-curious. You don't need to have worked on every part of a business, but you should be excited to.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

You’ll build and maintain backend services and data pipelines that power AI usage metering, reporting, billing integrations, and model availability. As part of a newly formed team, you’ll work closely with Product, AI, Business Intelligence, Finance, and Platform Engineering to solve complex technical and data challenges while helping establish the architecture and engineering practices that will support the team as it grows. 

You will: 

Design & Build

- Build cloud-native services using C#, AWS, and modern backend architecture patterns.

System Design & Architecture

Reliability & Operational Excellence

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production-grade systems.

- Experience with AWS or Azure and modern cloud-native backend architecture patterns.

- Experience building or maintaining data pipelines, event-driven systems, or analytics infrastructure.

- Experience designing and operating reliable production services.

- Experience collaborating across engineering, product, data, or other technical teams to deliver integrated solutions. 

What Will Make You Stand Out

- Experience with product analytics, instrumentation, or usage-based data systems.

- Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, and S3.

- Experience with Snowflake, Kafka, or similar data and event-streaming technologies.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

Compensation Transparency 

The compensation range for this position is: $145,000 - $165,000 

The posted cash compensation for this position includes on target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on various factors specific to each candidate, such as career level, skills, experience, geographic location, qualifications, and other job-related considerations. 

Equal Opportunity 

NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Senior Backend Engineer, VGo Carrier Technology
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Senior Backend Engineer in the Vinted Go Carrier domain, you will build backend systems that move parcels through Vinted Go's own logistics network, between hubs and through warehouses, quickly, reliably and at scale.

You'll join Vinted Go, the logistics arm of Vinted, focused on making shipping more affordable, convenient, and reliable. Your team, Pacman , owns mid-mile logistics and warehouse operations automation: how parcels are routed and transported between hubs, and how they are received, labelled, and dispatched.

We're looking for a strong engineer who also makes the engineers around them better: someone who leads the team's hardest technical problems and actively shares what they know, so the whole team grows with them.

In this position, you’ll 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power mid-mile transport and warehouse operations.

- Own technical initiatives end to end, from problem framing and system design through delivery, monitoring, and iteration, and lead projects that span the team or the wider domain.

- Make architecture and trade-off decisions with a 6–12 month horizon, balancing scalability, reliability, maintainability, and tech debt.

- Help evolve our core service, a large Ruby on Rails modular monolith, towards clearer module boundaries and well-defined APIs.

- Collaborate with Product, Operations, Decision Science, and neighboring engineering teams to shape discovery, sequencing, and implementation, and align on contracts and dependencies through RFCs and technical discussions.

- Actively share knowledge: give thoughtful code reviews, pair on hard problems, walk the team through complex changes, and keep documentation useful.

- Help onboard new team members, mentor engineers informally, and trust others with meaningful work while supporting them to succeed.

- Work with a backend stack that includes Ruby, Vitess, Kafka, Jenkins, Elastic, and observability tools; you do not need to know all of it upfront.

- Take ownership of service reliability, alerts, metrics, SLOs, and incident follow-up, including participation in on-call rotations.

- Take part in hiring by interviewing candidates and helping raise the bar.

- Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your development workflow and help the team move faster.

About you 

- 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of building systems and owning work from design through production.

- Solid experience with Ruby, or the ability and motivation to learn Vinted's backend stack quickly.

- Good understanding of API design, database-backed systems, observability, and operating services in production.

- Works independently on problems of diverse scope, and is someone teammates turn to for advice on difficult technical matters.

- Pragmatic problem solver who balances delivery speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

- Comfortable working with ambiguity and breaking complex product or operational problems into clear technical steps.

- Genuinely enjoys sharing knowledge and mentoring others, and sees raising the team's engineering standards as part of the job.

- Gives direct, useful feedback, seeks it in return, and builds alignment across teams.

- Collaborative and clear communicator who works well with engineers, product managers, operations, and non-technical stakeholders.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Advantage: experience with logistics, warehouse management, fulfillment, or operational workflows; integrating software with physical devices; or modularizing a large monolith.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 working days of holiday

- Access to all the tools & tech needed for work

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Private health insurance

- Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contribution from Vinted

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- A dog-friendly office

- In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices

- In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:

€76.800 — €104.000 EUR
